performance.verdict: Spend is live but zero GHL leads logged — pipeline blind, not ad-dead.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: 28 days of spend ($1,140.48) with 0 GHL leads logged — Google Ads reports 12 conversions but pipeline shows none.
OVERDUE (2026-08-31): Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 — speed-to-lead automations point at a vacant seat, blocking scale-up gate.
OVERDUE (2026-07-31 & 2026-08-31): Booking bot battle-test, Review Boost campaign, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA re-enable (2026-09-01) all undelivered.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Aug 30–Sep 1), down from a 28-day average of ~4.4/day — organic visibility effectively gone in this window.

Google spend erratic (range $0–$130/day over 45 days): 3-day signal (Aug 30–Sep 1: $28.67, $86.87, $97.13) vs prior 3 (Aug 27–29: $19.61, $11.08, $2.73) shows spend ramping, but 0 leads logged either window — efficiency unverifiable.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake seat immediately: confirm who owns the inbox and that automations route to a live login — unblocks all scaling.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and no replacement intake owner has been confirmed, meaning speed-to-lead automations are pointing at a vacant seat. Google Ads shows 12 conversions in 28 days against $1,140.48 spend, yet GHL shows 0 leads — the most likely cause is a broken intake routing, not ad failure. Action: Nacer to confirm the named intake owner, verify their GHL login is active, and test that a new contact triggers the automation correctly. Success check: at least 1 GHL lead appears within 48 hours of fix — confirm by 2026-09-04.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget changes until intake fix (S1) is confirmed; re-check GBP 3-day trend on 2026-09-05.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for 3 straight days (Aug 30–Sep 1), down from a 28-day average of ~4.4/day, and GA4 sessions are unmeasured. Google spend is ramping ($97.13 on Sep 1) but CPL is uncomputable with 0 pipeline leads. Per the SOW scale-back-up gate, budgets must not be raised until intake is confirmed staffed and working. Re-check GBP trend and GHL lead flow on 2026-09-05 — if GBP recovers and ≥3 leads appear in GHL, escalate to Sohib for budget review.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer: LSA re-enable, booking bot, review boost, financing page, Homer Glen branch.
